the sociocultural context of child mental health in the Arab region, and the implications for the development of mental health services in the region.

parents of children with psychiatric disorders in the United Arab Emirate are less likely to seek professional help from mental health professionals, and this is related to sociodemographic factors, parental attitudes, and stigma.
